# SaltWatch Card 0.5.2

This release makes first-time setup clearer and keeps irrelevant configuration controls out of the way until a valid SaltWatch device is selected.

## What changed

- Renamed the editor's **Live data** section to **SaltWatch device** so the purpose of the selector is immediately clear.
- Replaced the cramped missing-device error in the preview with a centered, styled setup prompt.
- Hidden layout, value, visibility, and action settings until a complete SaltWatch device has been selected.
- Added distinct guidance for initial loading, no selection, incomplete devices, devices that have disappeared, and Home Assistant registry failures.
- Kept the full editor available as soon as the selected device exposes all required SaltWatch entities.
- Added English and German translations for the new setup states.
- Fixed missing card styles in early setup and error render paths.

## Compatibility

- Existing cards with a valid SaltWatch device remain unchanged.
- No YAML configuration changes are required.
- SaltWatch Card continues to require an official SaltWatch device running firmware 2.0.0 or newer.

## Validation

- 49 unit tests passed.
- 39 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile profiles; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- The release workflow rebuilds and publishes the checked JavaScript asset.
